decisions.why: large and medium reusable hot/cold soft gel packs, stated as reusable hot/cold on the products themselves. Follows the recorded decision for Farla Medical's 'Hot & Cold Packs' division.
single-use instant ice packs sold by the box of 50 — cold therapy, the same category as Farla Medical's 'Hot & Cold Packs'.
the IB01 orthopaedic ice wrap 22x46cm and its IPCIB01 cover — a limb cold-therapy wrap, named orthopaedic by the company itself.
IP23 and IP4 Cool Cubes, the company's reusable ice-pack line, with their covers — cold therapy packs.
IP42 and IP32 Cool Cubes in paediatric sizes — the same reusable cold-therapy ice packs, sized for children.

the supplier's own site groups this 2-product division under medichill.co.uk/collections/4-maternity; its own product page for the IP22 Cool Cubes (medichill.co.uk/products/medichill-cool-cubes-small-15x6cm) describes them as 'the choice for maternity wards and midwives worldwide', 'designed for perineal relief post-childbirth' — postpartum perineal cold therapy, not general cold therapy like the supplier's other Cool Cubes ranges.
